note: Known-good serving rates per rung. A rung below 80% of baseline is degraded, not noisy -- 0.80 is chosen to catch the ~22% loss serve-arc.cmd attributes to a partial VRAM spill, the quietest real degradation this box produces. Re-baseline ONLY after verifying the rung by other means (placement via ff_census.py, then a deliberate A/B), and ONLY on a server that is FRESH AFTER RESTART (ADR-0041): a burst measurement is valid on a fresh server and meaningless on a poisoned one.

omen-arc.config: knee build e85caa8, -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1 -fa on --no-mmap -dio -fit off -c 131072 -np 2 (ub default 512)
